summary: Deliver provider-neutral contracts and a persistent Studio-first local runtime with recoverable processing/delivery, exact money, and shared local/HTTP conformance.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Validated four ports isolate workflow/tool code from concrete mocks/vendor SDKs. Independent tenant/case bindings persist; defaults cannot redirect existing effects.
acceptance_criteria.proof: Import audit and contract tests across distinct accounts/tenants/bindings.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Versioned reversible migrations preserve legacy cases and Mastra tables; CAS and all domain, action, event, dispatch/outbox records survive reopen.
acceptance_criteria.proof: Migration up/down/up, failed rollback, stale-write rejection and reopen assertions.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Exact money with checked legacy boundary; atomic refunds prevent over-refund; replay returns persisted effect and conflicting reuse fails.
acceptance_criteria.proof: Precision/currency/range, concurrent partial refunds, key conflict and restart after effect.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Existing approval persists immutable command linkage; missing/rejected/tampered commands and execution bypass fail. Existing approve/reject works without claiming PHASE003 compliance.
Persistent deterministic commerce/knowledge, ambiguous lookup rejection, repeatable seed and scoped reset preserving unrelated data.
Inbound acceptance atomically persists deduplicated event/message/case/dispatch. Stable run IDs and bounded claims recover work without approving suspended runs.
acceptance_criteria.proof: Concurrent duplicates and actual workflow restart across pre-start/active/suspended boundaries.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Durable bound outbox with classified bounded retry and receipts; workflow/action/delivery status separate and terminal failure visible.
acceptance_criteria.proof: Timeout/429/5xx/permanent/dropped-response, concurrent claims, restart and receipt replay.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Optional loopback HTTP facade and adapter pass shared in-process conformance with validated boundaries.
acceptance_criteria.proof: Shared tests both transports including timeout and post-commit dropped response.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Documented Studio startup uses deterministic local fixtures, preserves registry/context and compatible demo flows.
acceptance_criteria.proof: Startup smoke, context/registry checks and relevant E2E journeys.

test_obligations.mandatory_gates: All20 approved gates check-only, no exceptions
test_obligations.coverage: New meaningful unit, shared contract, real SQLite/restart/migration/concurrency and E2E evidence; existing green gates alone insufficient
test_obligations.review: P0/P1 resolved; P2 resolved or human-approved deferral; mandatory human merge authorization
